name: Pipeliners - AI Answer City Headings 2026-09-29
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-29

# Summary
City-page question headings added Sep 29, 2026 on six city pages: Avondale, Carefree, Goodyear, Rio Verde, Sun City and Surprise. The guarded apply script required the live `_elementor_data` to equal the saved "before" copy and was a dry run unless explicitly enabled.

# Key findings
- Purpose (per later notes): give each page a question-style heading for AI answers. Later drafts found the text under these headings was not yet a 40 to 60 word answer-first block (for example Avondale, Goodyear and Sun City in the Oct 9 strengthen drafts).
- The SEO Results Scorecard flags these Sep 29 changes as falling inside other measurement windows.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `before/` and `after/` Elementor JSON per city, `before/live-*.html`, `live/`, `apply_city.php`.
